pure-announcement.rationale: The Research feature is only the case study; the substance is transferable architecture, prompting, evaluation and reliability lessons.

duplicate.rationale: The nearest concepts cover retrieval evals and MCP mechanics — none covers orchestrator-worker multi-agent design or its economics, and the eval concepts would still learn the LLM-as-judge and end-state findings here.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Claims are grounded in described internal experiments with named benchmarks (BrowseComp) and mechanisms a reader can reproduce.

durability.rationale: The load-bearing content is pattern and trade-off — parallel context windows as token scaling, 15x cost economics, effort-scaling rules, end-state evaluation, artifact references over relaying — which outlives the cited model names and percentages.

actionability.rationale: It prescribes specifics a builder can lift: delegate with objective, output format, tool guidance and boundaries; start evals at ~20 queries; use one rubric-based judge call; resume from checkpoints instead of restarting.

atomicity.rationale: It bundles at least three separable concepts — multi-agent token-scaling economics, agent evaluation methodology, and production reliability for stateful agents — that no single paragraph captures without becoming a list.
